title: Bonus · Sentence ladders 1 + 2 · Latin only (× 3)
summary: Ladders 1 and 2 (rebuilt 24 Oct) in Latin only. Rebuilt 24 Oct: the top of every ladder now comes back at least 3 times (if…, that…, comparisons, questions), every new word is used 3+ times, and it is about 50% longer. Latin read from IPA (v as v), free voices.
